run_text_classification_pipeline: run the TextClassificationPipeline to classify text sentiment using a sequence classification model
apply_sigmoid_to_classification_scores: apply the sigmoid function to binary classification model outputs for probability scores
apply_softmax_to_classification_scores: apply the softmax function to multi-label classification model outputs for normalized probability scores
configure_classification_function: configure the ClassificationFunction enum to control sigmoid, softmax, or none score transformation
sanitize_pipeline_parameters: sanitize TextClassificationPipeline parameters for preprocessing, forward, and postprocessing stages
